title_sq: Shitet shtepi private ne zonen e Kombinatit (ID 4141018)
description_sq:
Ne zonen e Kombinatit prane Depove te Ujit shitet shtepi private nje kateshe me siperfaqe ndertimi 100 m² dhe siperfaqe trualli 300 m². Shtepia organizohet ne ambient ndenje dhe gatimi, 3 dhoma gjumi, koridor shperndares, tualet, verande.
Shtepia ofron nje pamje te lire te Kombinatit, ndodhet ne zone te qete larg zhurmave te qytetitm ka kopesht me peme frutore dhe orientim me diell.
Shitet e mobiluar, ne cmim perfshihet dhe garazhd i pershtatshem per nje makine.
Disponon hipoteke.
Cmimi 190 000 euro .
title_en: Private house for sale in Kombinat area (ID 4141018)
description_en: In the Kombinat area, near the Water Storage, a private one-story house with a construction area of ​​100 m² and a plot area of ​​300 m² is for sale. The house is organized in living room and kitchen, 3 bedrooms, distribution corridor, toilet, veranda. The house offers a free view of the complex, it is located in a quiet area away from the noise of the city, it has a garden with fruit trees and a sunny orientation. For sale furnished, the price includes a garage suitable for one car. Has a mortgage. The price is 190,000 euros.
